lien_type: 1. IRS federal tax liens DO NOT automatically extinguish in a state tax sale. If IRS lien is on record, taxing entities must give IRS 25-day advance notice (IRC 7425). Failure to do so may allow IRS to redeem within 120 days.
2. The adjudged value ($877,917) vs. minimum bid ($192,085) gap suggests significant equity. This increases likelihood of active mortgage/deed of trust on the property.
3. Multi-family properties frequently have multiple encumbrances. A 1950-built building that has been delinquent on taxes since 2016 may have been used as collateral for multiple loans.
4. Tax sale does NOT clear all liens. Only ad valorem tax liens and junior liens are extinguished. Senior liens (including some federal liens) survive.
